summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan: ARCA-61 — Watchlist persistence bug  **Root cause hypothesis (high confidence, needs quick confirmation before fixing):** `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own router-level auth middleware (lines 13-21) that authenticates the session cookie correctly, but then injects the resolved user id via `c.req.raw.headers.set("X-User-Id", user.id)`. Downstream handlers read it back via `c.req.header("X-User-Id")` (via a local `getUserId()` helper). In Hono, mutating `c.req.raw.headers` inside router-scoped middleware is not reliably visible to `c.req.header()` in the same request — thi
